articles.title: DSSSB releases results for multiple posts at dsssb.delhi.gov.in: Direct link to download merit list for Pharmacist, Craft Instructor here
articles.summary: The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) has released the results for multiple posts, including Pharmacist and Craft Instructor. Aspirants can now access and download the merit lists directly from the official DSSSB website, dsssb.delhi.gov.in. This announcement is crucial for candidates who appeared for these examinations, providing a significant update on their recruitment status.
